name: a fictitious quadcopter drone control board
chain: The circuit is a fictitious quadcopter drone control board, studied on one motor channel: the 14.8 V battery enters through fuse FU1 then bulk capacitor C1 to the battery rail. The battery rail feeds two branches. Logic branch: step-down converter U1 chops the battery rail; its switching node is smoothed by inductor L1 to produce the 5 V rail. The 5 V rail powers radio receiver RX1 and regulator U2, which produces the 3.3 V rail. The 3.3 V rail powers quartz oscillator Y1, inertial measurement unit U4 and flight microcontroller U3. U3 is clocked by the Y1 clock, receives the pilot setpoint from RX1, polls U4 over the sensor bus that it clocks itself, and produces the motor PWM command. Power branch: gate driver U5, powered by the battery rail, amplifies the PWM command; its output passes through gate resistor R1 to the gate of MOSFET Q1, which switches the motor current measured by the shunt. Freewheeling diode D1 is in parallel with the motor.
